title: AIR Prompt Edition Manifest

HR_HUMAN_READABLE.label: HR / Familiar AIR
HR_HUMAN_READABLE.purpose: Byte-preserved verbose prompt edition for existing users, manual attachment, audit, learning, and compatibility.

MO_MACHINE_OPTIMIZED.label: MO / Machine-Optimized AIR
MO_MACHINE_OPTIMIZED.purpose: Compiled, dependency-closed, task-specific AIR representation with equivalent or stricter governing behavior.

invariants: HR and MO editions share mandatory governance invariant identifiers.
HR is a representation and compatibility edition, not weaker governance.
No edition may hide a material gate, blocker, evidence requirement, or approval scope.
MO becomes default only after structural, semantic, cross-edition, and behavioral regression validation.
Root compatibility paths are not removed until a separately approved migration release.
Specialist edition splits are required only where representation differs; shared source registries may remain common.
A source change affecting shared governance must trigger validation of both editions.
